title: Platform Operation Capability
statement: The railway organization must be capable of operating the platform in production.
evidence_excerpt: The railway organization must be capable of operating the platform in production.

title: Data Collection Identification and Classification
statement: Identify what information the platform collects and classify the data appropriately.
evidence_excerpt: You must identify what information the platform collects and classify the data appropriately.

title: Data Privacy and Handling Documentation
statement: Document important privacy and data-handling decisions.
evidence_excerpt: Important privacy and data-handling decisions should be documented.

title: AI Usage Demonstration
statement: Demonstrate where AI was used, how generated output was validated, and where your own judgment changed or rejected AI suggestions.
evidence_excerpt: You should demonstrate where AI was used, how generated output was validated, and where your own judgment changed or rejected AI suggestions.
